audience.en: A couple from Recife, Brazil (Thiago, 29, a software developer, and Camila, 28, a registered nurse) with BRL 140,000 saved, planning Canadian permanent residence through Express Entry with Calgary as the first city.
audience.pt-BR: Um casal do Recife (Thiago, 29 anos, desenvolvedor de software, e Camila, 28 anos, enfermeira registrada) com BRL 140.000 de economias, que planeja a residência permanente no Canadá pelo Express Entry, com Calgary como primeira cidade.

localeReason: Portuguese serves this couple directly: they live in Recife and will handle Brazilian documents (the Federal Police certificate, sworn translations, a French course in Recife) and talk to Brazilian test centres in Portuguese, while the official Canadian rules stay in English and French. It changes no score, rule, fee or date.

french_points.label: CRS points added by French (NCLC 7 in all four skills): 12 second language + 50 bonus

french_score.label: Thiago's CRS score at English CLB 8 plus French NCLC 7 (scenario A2+F; clears 11 of 12 French rounds in 2026)

healthcare_range.label: Healthcare category cut-offs, eight rounds July 2025 to September 2026

funds_required.label: Settlement funds for a family of 2 (IRCC table dated 7 July 2025; a 2026 table not confirmed)

pre_arrival.label: Estimated costs before arrival (includes placeholders and unconfirmed third-party prices)

left_at_application.label: Left from BRL 140,000 at application, at 3.8986 BRL per CAD (planning figure)

planningAssumptions.people: Thiago, 29, software developer, about 6 years' experience; Camila, 28, registered nurse, about 4 years; both with a bachelor's degree; no Canadian work, no job offer. English levels are estimates (Thiago CLB 8-9, Camila CLB 7), not test results.
planningAssumptions.rates: 1 CAD = 3.8986 BRL (Bank of Canada, 6 November 2026); savings BRL 140,000 = C$35,910; amounts rounded line by line.
planningAssumptions.costs: Placeholders: French preparation R$6,000, translations R$1,500, medicals R$800 each, flights R$4,500 each, one month's deposit, groceries C$700 a month, phone and internet C$160, utilities C$120, furniture C$2,000, winter clothing C$800, eating out C$300 a month, health contingency C$300, 10% contingency; retake allowances for IELTS and TCF once each. Rent C$1,431 is a third-party average.
planningAssumptions.recommendation: Thiago as principal applicant; invest in French (NCLC 7 in all four skills, +62 CRS points; 420 clears 11 of 12 French rounds in 2026); healthcare draws needed 462-476; the 3 November 2026 Labour Market Integration factor is 0 for them (our inference, not checked against the old grid); not legal or immigration advice.

datePolicy: Pages were read on 2026-11-07 UTC (2026-11-08 local) in the original run; sources whose figure was seen only in a search snippet or whose tool did not render have access date unknown. Round dates, table dates (7 July 2025) and the 3 November 2026 rule change are source dates, not access dates. Copy editing and translation are not a refresh.
uncertainties: FSW education points (21 for a three-year-plus bachelor's) come from memory of the IRCC grid; the lookup table did not render. Camila's FSW total of 67 has zero margin.

The TEER 1 classification of NOC 21232 and 31301, the IELTS-to-CLB mapping, the 9-18 months of French study, ECA turnaround and about 6 months of PR processing are unconfirmed or estimates; the processing-times tool did not render.

The inference that the 3 November 2026 CRS change does not alter their scores was not checked against the superseded grid; age counted on the invitation date was not found in the page text. All cut-offs predate the change.

Budget lines marked placeholder or assumed have no source (French tuition, translations, medicals, flights, deposit, groceries, telecom, utilities, furniture, clothing, eating out, health contingency, 10% contingency, retakes).

Third-party or snippet prices: WES ECA C$264, WES courier C$97 (column inferred), IELTS R$1,360 (snippet), TCF Canada R$1,335 (Sao Paulo, snippet), Calgary rent C$1,431 (a July 2026 snippet shows C$1,593).
Not found: TEF Canada price, NNAS fee, panel-physician fee in Recife, sworn translation and apostille prices, Rentals.ca figure, groceries, telecom, deposit rule, airfares.
The proof-of-funds table (C$19,001) is dated 7 July 2025; a 2026 table was not confirmed. The R$ equivalent is shown as R$74,077 (19,001 x 3.8986 = 74,077.3).

The re-check after four corrections (French clearing count 3 not 5, the 46% rise in BRL per CAD, runway about 4.8 months, wording) was done by the guide's author, not by an outside reviewer; the earlier full recomputation by a separate reviewer did not reopen every rule page.

provenance.sourceAccessMethod: Local files only. The README locale contract and VOICE-GUIDE were read first, then the run's index.html, sources.md and independent-check.md. No network research, build or publication during authoring. The Brazilian Portuguese page was translated from the English guide.
provenance.originalResearchAccessLimitations: The original research read pages through DeTars' fetch pipeline and managed browser profile without sign-ins; Rentals.ca, Numbeo, Telus and NNAS refused automated access. The TEF Canada price, NNAS fee, panel-physician price and Recife translation prices were not found. The IRCC language-equivalency chart and education-points lookup did not render. The URL for French category round 452 (S4) was given in the run only as a query suffix and is not listed.
provenance.independentCheckDisposition: A separate reviewer recomputed the CRS, FSW, draw statistics and budget arithmetic and checked live IRCC pages; it found the French clearing count for 396 was 3 not 5, the 46% was a rise in BRL per CAD (the real loses about 32%), the runway was about 4.8 months not about 3, and smaller wording and rounding points; the run fixed the four medium items, and the author, not an outsider, re-checked them. The reviewer could not confirm the FSW education value 21. This page also shows R$74,077 and R$1,403 where the run's rounding differed by one real, and notes that displayed lines can differ from totals by C$1.
